message: shorter items' backgrounds won't stretch in a wrapping row
hint: Wrapped items are separate inline blocks, so painted cards of different heights on one line stay ragged. Use align-items: flex-start to make that explicit.

message: flex-grow in a wrapping row is resolved at the design width (300px); below it, grown items keep that width as a cap
hint: On a phone, stacked grow items fill the line only up to their grown width, and a line stacks earlier than in the browser.
